plan.title: UI-AWD-004 Bid Selection Proposal re-enters the flow

steps.note: Open the prepared event directly on Master QCS where a draft proposal exists
Assert the Bid Selection Proposal control is present
Assert the Draft tag is shown on the proposal entry
Click the entry control to re-enter the awarding flow
Assert navigation into the awarding flow succeeded
